title: Duplicate rule records for ten combat actions

Add membership regression evidence and regenerate/verify without weakening existing expectations.
acceptance_criteria: Every listed duplicate has a source-backed disposition; permanent evidence protects the resulting action ownership; regenerated pack verification passes.
